proposed.knowledge_statement: Generalized 3 Hz spike-and-wave discharges on EEG with brief staring spells are characteristic of typical absence seizures.

candidates.canonical_statement: Typical absence seizures are characterized by brief staring spells with impaired awareness, no postictal confusion, and generalized 3-Hz spike-and-wave discharges on EEG.
Infantile spasms present as clusters of brief flexor or extensor spasms in infancy and are associated with hypsarrhythmia on EEG.

proposed.knowledge_statement: Clusters of brief flexor spasms in infancy with hypsarrhythmia on EEG are diagnostic of infantile spasms.

candidates.canonical_statement: Infantile spasms present as clusters of brief flexor or extensor spasms in infancy and are associated with hypsarrhythmia on EEG.
Typical absence seizures are characterized by brief staring spells with generalized 3-Hz spike-and-wave discharges on EEG.

proposed.knowledge_statement: In bronchiolitis, escalating oxygen requirement, lethargy, and increasing work of breathing indicate impending respiratory failure and require transfer to a pediatric intensive care unit.

proposed.knowledge_statement: In a neonate with risk factors for early-onset sepsis and mild respiratory symptoms, blood cultures should be obtained and empiric antibiotics started, even if the infant appears well.

candidates.canonical_statement: In a neonate with suspected sepsis, empiric intravenous antibiotics (ampicillin and gentamicin) should be started immediately after blood cultures are obtained, without waiting for results.
